title: Family Mystery Picnic on the Mornington Peninsula
summary: Self-guided family scavenger journey: solve smartphone clues, collect picnic goodies from local providers, hit activity stops, and feast at a scenic picnic location. Runs Thursday to Sunday weekly.
accessibilityNotes: Self-guided across multiple venues; accessibility varies. Contact organisers for specific requirements.
weatherDependency: Mostly outdoor; winter-viable with the right gear
nearbyAttractions: Arthurs Seat Eagle; Ashcombe Maze; Mornington foreshore
suggestedItineraryPairing: Mystery Picnic as the centrepiece of a school holiday Peninsula day — pair with Arthurs Seat Eagle faux snow in the morning
editorVerdict: Makes a proper day of it for families in a way that a single activity doesn't. The scavenger structure keeps kids engaged across the whole route.
editorNote:
Shire-organised self-guided experience for families. You get digital clues on your smartphone, solve them to find the next stop, collect picnic food from local providers along the way, hit one or two activity stops, and the whole thing ends at a scenic picnic spot.

Runs Thursday to Sunday weekly. Book ahead so the picnic food is ready at the collection points.

Good pairing with Arthurs Seat Eagle in the same week for families doing multiple school holiday days on the Peninsula. Dress the kids for winter; the picnic spots are outdoors.
